description.zh: 建议生成的日期。格式：yyyyMMdd（UTC时间）。
description.en: The date when the optimization suggestions were generated. Specify the date in the `yyyyMMdd` format. The date is in UTC.

description.zh: 待批量应用的建议ID列表，多个建议ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The IDs of the optimization suggestions that you want to apply. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
Specifies whether to immediately start the build task.

description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the data warehouse cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of data warehouse clusters.
The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
